mapper.sql: id, series_id, season_year, season_name, display_title, description, cover_file_id, banner_file_id, match_start_time, match_end_time, publish_status, season_status, create_time, update_time, is_delete
mapper.select: select from basket_season where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0

select se.id, se.series_id, s.series_code, s.series_name, se.season_year, se.season_name, se.display_title, se.description, se.cover_file_id, se.banner_file_id, cf.access_url as cover_url, bf.access_url as banner_url, se.match_start_time, se.match_end_time, se.publish_status, se.season_status, (select count(1) from basket_division d where d.season_id = se.id and d.is_delete = 0) as division_count, se.create_time, se.update_time from basket_season se left join basket_series s on s.id = se.series_id and s.is_delete = 0 left join basket_file_asset cf on cf.id = se.cover_file_id and cf.is_delete = 0 left join basket_file_asset bf on bf.id = se.banner_file_id and bf.is_delete = 0 where se.is_delete = 0 and se.id = #{id} and se.series_id = #{seriesId} and s.series_code = #{seriesCode} and se.season_year = #{seasonYear} and se.season_name like concat('%', #{seasonName}, '%') and se.display_title like concat('%', #{displayTitle}, '%') and se.publish_status = #{publishStatus} and se.season_status = #{seasonStatus} order by se.id desc
select count(1) from basket_division where season_id = #{seasonId} and is_delete = 0
mapper.update:
update basket_season
series_id = #{seriesId}, season_year = #{seasonYear}, season_name = #{seasonName}, display_title = #{displayTitle}, description = #{description}, cover_file_id = #{coverFileId}, banner_file_id = #{bannerFileId}, match_start_time = #{seasonStartTime}, match_end_time = #{seasonEndTime}, publish_status = #{publishStatus}, season_status = #{seasonStatus}, update_time = now()
where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
update basket_season set is_delete = 1, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
